public_rationale: The July 23, 2025 AI Action Plan addresses existing deepfake risks, and the April 23, 2025 education order gives practical reasons for AI literacy and teacher training [e3, e4]. These provisions weigh against a literal reading that every policy depends on imminent AGI, but do not establish the governing premise of the overall strategy [e3, e4]. The July 23 announcement describes AI as central to economic and military leadership without establishing reliance on imminent AGI [e5]. Together, these documents leave unresolved whether imminent AGI governed national AI policy through November 21, 2025, or whether analysis supporting that premise was unsound [e3, e4, e5].
limitations: The packet lacks policy-development records and the technical analyses actually relied upon during January 20–November 21, 2025.
Announced goals do not establish all assumptions behind policy adoption.
Practical policy examples do not settle the claim about overall policy direction.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: The US has built, and continues to build, its entire national policy (such as it is) around an idea, in context the AI 2027 picture of imminent AGI, that was never grounded in a sound analysis of AI.
conditions: entire national policy (such as it is)

statement.excerpt: Suffice for now to say that we have built (and continue to build) our entire national policy (such as it is) around an idea that was never grounded in a sound analysis of AI.
statement.document_title: BREAKING: The AI 2027 doomsday scenario has officially been postponed

from_speaker: we have built (and continue to build)
our entire national policy (such as it is)
never grounded in a sound analysis of AI
our_interpretation: National policy means national AI policy in this passage, not every federal policy.
The idea is imminent AGI, associated with AI 2027 and arrival during Trump's second term.
The ordinary claim is that imminent AGI serves as the governing premise of national AI policy and lacks adequate analytical support. Entire need not mean every minor provision.
The target interval covers the current administration through the post date, because built and continue to build describe both its policy development and the ongoing position.
Sound analysis requires explicit reasoning grounded in capability evidence and uncertainty; disagreement with a forecast alone does not establish unsoundness.
criteria.support_condition: Policy-development records and technical rationales show that national AI policy rests throughout on imminent AGI, with material analytical defects in the evidence supporting that premise.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Records establish that substantial national AI policies rest on present capabilities or independently justified goals and that imminent AGI is not their governing premise, or directly establish sound analysis for the allegedly unsupported premise.
